book.subtitle_en: A study guide, not a reprint of the original. Each idea is retold in simpler English, with a Chinese translation, key vocabulary, and a one-day action plan.
book.subtitle_zh: 这不是原文转载，而是一本精读学习书：把一篇很长的英文长文拆成 7 个小节，用更简单的英文重新讲清楚每个观点，再配中文翻译、重点词汇和一日行动手册。读完能懂意思，也能学到表达。
book.title_en: Fix Your Life in One Day — a study guide for English learners

how_to.en: Switch between bilingual / English only / Chinese only at the top. Read side by side first, then try English only.
how_to.zh: 顶部可以切换中英对照 / 纯英文 / 仅中文，先对照读，再试着只读英文。

how_to.en: Tap a vocabulary card to see its Chinese meaning and an example. Tap the speaker icon to hear it (browser speech).
how_to.zh: 点每个生词卡片展开中文意思和例句，点 🔊 可以听发音（用浏览器自带语音）。

how_to.en: Tick a chapter when you finish it. Progress and the table of contents update together. Flashcards, a quiz, and a one-day plan are at the end. Your written answers stay only in your own browser.
how_to.zh: 每章读完勾选 ✅，进度条和目录会同步。最后有词汇闪卡、小测验和一日行动手册，写下来的答案只保存在你自己的浏览器里。

source.author: Dan Koe
source.note_en: Published 13 Jan 2026. This is a study summary. Ideas belong to the author; use the X link for the original.
source.note_zh: 原文发表于 2026 年 1 月 13 日。本页为学习笔记与概括，观点归原作者所有；想引用原文请以 X 链接为准。
